info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens History Case API

params.name: caseInstanceId
params.description: An id of the historic case instance.

params.name: caseInstanceIds
params.description: Only return historic case instances with the given comma-separated ids.

params.name: caseDefinitionKey
params.description: The case definition key of the historic case instance.

params.name: caseDefinitionKeyLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition key.

params.name: caseDefinitionKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition key, ignoring case.

params.name: caseDefinitionId
params.description: The case definition id of the historic case instance.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategory
params.description: Only return historic case instances with the given case definition category.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategoryLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition category.

params.name: caseDefinitionCategoryLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition category, ignoring case.

params.name: caseDefinitionName
params.description: Only return historic case instances with the given case definition name.

params.name: caseDefinitionNameLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition name.

params.name: caseDefinitionNameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given case definition name, ignoring case.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return historic case instances with the given name.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given name.

params.name: nameLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given name ignoring case.

params.name: rootScopeId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given root scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: parentScopeId
params.description: Only return case instances which have the given parent scope id (that can be a process or case instance ID).

params.name: businessKey
params.description: The business key of the historic case instance.

params.name: businessKeyLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given business key.

params.name: businessKeyLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given business key, ignoring case.

params.name: businessStatus
params.description: The business status of the historic case instance.

params.name: businessStatusLike
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given business status.

params.name: businessStatusLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return historic case instances like the given business status, ignoring case.

params.name: involvedUser
params.description: An involved user of the historic case instance.

params.name: finished
params.description: Indication if the historic case instance is finished.

params.name: finishedAfter
params.description: Return only historic case instances that were finished after this date.

params.name: finishedBefore
params.description: Return only historic case instances that were finished before this date.

params.name: startedAfter
params.description: Return only historic case instances that were started after this date.

params.name: startedBefore
params.description: Return only historic case instances that were started before this date.

params.name: startedBy
params.description: Return only historic case instances that were started by this user.

params.name: state
params.description: Only return historic case instances with the given state.

params.name: callbackId
params.description: Only return historic case instances which have the given callback id.

params.name: callbackType
params.description: Only return historic case instances which have the given callback type.

params.name: parentCaseInstanceId
params.description: Only return historic case instances which have the given parent case instance id.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: Only return historic case instances which have the given reference id.

params.name: referenceType
params.description: Only return historic case instances which have the given reference type.

params.name: lastReactivatedBy
params.description: Only return historic case instances last reactived by the given user.

params.name: lastReactivatedBefore
params.description: Only return historic case instances last reactivated before the given date.

params.name: lastReactivatedAfter
params.description: Only return historic case instances last reactivated after the given date.

params.name: activePlanItemDefinitionId
params.description: Only return historic case instances that have an active plan item instance with the given plan item definition id.

params.name: includeCaseVariables
params.description: An indication if the historic case instance variables should be returned as well.

params.name: includeCaseVariablesName
params.description: Indication to include case variables with the given names in the result.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return instances with the given tenant id.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return instances like the given tenant id.

params.name: tenantIdLikeIgnoreCase
params.description: Only return instances like the given tenant id, ignoring case.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

params.name: withoutCaseInstanceParentId
params.description: If true, only returns instances without a parent set. If false, the withoutCaseInstanceParentId parameter is ignored.

params.name: withoutCaseInstanceCallbackId
params.description: If true, only returns instances without a callbackId set. If false, the withoutCaseInstanceCallbackId parameter is ignored.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic case instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long. On top of that, the query allows for filtering based on process variables. The variables property is a JSON-array containing objects with the format as described here.
